FIFO leftover service for flow i at a port with sharing set S: R_i = R - sum_{j in S, j!=i} rho_j; T_i = (R*T + sum_{j in S, j!=i} sigma_j) / R_i
Single-port delay bound for flow i: D_port_i = T_i + sigma_i / R_i = (sum_{j in S} sigma_j) / (R - sum_{j in S, j!=i} rho_j)
End-to-end delay: D_e2e_i = sum_over_egress_ports_on_path(D_port_i) + hop_count * t_prop + (hop_count - 1) * t_sw + t_sync
notes: All flows are AVB Class A in queue 6; only CBS is active; no other priority classes assumed => T = 0 for CBS service curve.
Switches are FIFO within PCP, so FIFO leftover service applies.
With T = 0 at each port, burst does not grow across hops in this model (sigma_out <= sigma_in + rho*T = sigma_in).
Fixed delays additively: propagation and switching per hop/switch; time sync error counted once end-to-end.

cbs_parameters.arrival_curve: alpha_i(t) = sigma_i + rho_i * t, with sigma_i = L_i_bits, rho_i = L_i_bits / period_us (Mbps)

equations.per_port_delay: D_port_f = T_f + sigma_f / R'_f = (I*T + sum_all sigma) / R'_f

F0.equation_used: WCD(flow) = sum_over_egress_ports [ (Σ b_port)/R + T_port + 1us_switch + 1us_prop ] + 1us_time_sync, with R=IdleSlope and T_port = Lmax_bits*(1/C + (C-IdleSlope)/(C*IdleSlope)).

constants.Queue: AVB Class A, PCP=6, mapped exclusively to queue 6

WCD_calculation.arrival_curve_per_flow: alpha_f(t) = b_f + r_f * t, where b_f = payload_bits, r_f = payload_bits / period_us (in bits/us = Mbps).
WCD_calculation.CBS_service_curve_per_port: beta_port(t) = R * [t - T_port]^+, with R = IdleSlope = 75 bits/us and T_port = Lmax_bits*(1/C + (C - IdleSlope)/(C*IdleSlope)) = Lmax_bits/75 us (since C=100 bits/us, IdleSlope=75 bits/us).
WCD_calculation.per_port_delay_bound: D_port = (Σ b_port)/R + T_port + 1us_switch + 1us_prop = ((Σ b_port) + Lmax_bits)/75 + 2 us.
WCD_calculation.end_to_end_WCD: WCD(flow) = sum(D_port over all egress ports used by the flow) + time_sync_error_us.

Presence/absence of other traffic classes (e.g., Best Effort) on the same egress ports; assumed none share queue 6 and no higher-priority preemption.
Exact hiCredit/loCredit configuration; assumed hiCredit=0 due to no non-AVB blocking, loCredit derived from slopes and Lmax.
Preemption not used; non-preemptive transmission assumed.

all_parameters_used.server_model: Per egress port rate-latency service curve with R = IdleSlope, T = (L_max_bits/C_bits_per_us) * ((C-IdleSlope)/IdleSlope) = L_max_bits/300 microseconds
all_parameters_used.arrival_curve_model: Per-flow leaky-bucket alpha_i(t) = sigma_i + rho_i * t, with sigma_i = L_i_bits, rho_i = L_i_bits / period_us (in Mbps)

WCD_calculation.per_port_service_curve: beta_port(t) = R * (t - T_cbs)+ with R = IdleSlope and T_cbs = (L_max_bits/C) * ((C - IdleSlope)/IdleSlope) = L_max_bits / 300 microseconds (C=100 Mb/s, I=75 Mb/s).
WCD_calculation.arrival_curve: alpha_i(t) = sigma_i + rho_i * t with sigma_i = L_i_bits and rho_i = (L_i_bits / period_us) Mbps.
WCD_calculation.end_to_end_WCD: For flow i along links j=1..H: WCD_i = sum_j Dq_port(j) + H * prop_delay + (H - 1) * switch_delay. Here prop_delay = 1 us per hop; switch_delay = 1 us per switch (cut-through).

Switches are cut-through; no store-and-forward serialization delay modeled beyond CBS T_cbs and fixed switching delay.

WCD_calculation.method: Separate Flow Analysis with CBS-modeled rate-latency servers per egress port; blind multiplexing ignored beyond single-frame non-preemptive blocking via Lmax per port (conservative), CBS credit latency via loCredit.
steps: Identify egress ports on each hop from provided routes and edge map; all flows mapped to queue PCP 6 (AVB Class A).
For each egress port p: compute Lmax_p = max payload (bytes) of all flows using p; compute T_p = Lmax_p/C + Lmax_p*(C - I)/(C*I) + t_sw + t_prop.
Arrival curve per flow i: alpha_i(t) = sigma_i + rho_i t with sigma_i = 8*L_i, rho_i = 8*L_i / P_i.
Per-hop worst-case delay for flow i at port p: D_{i,p} = T_p + sigma_i/I = T_p + (8*L_i)/I.
End-to-end bound: WCD_i = sum_p D_{i,p} + t_src_prop + t_sync.
